From ce4e25198a6aaaaf36248edf8daf3d744ec8e309 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Felix Gu <ustc.gu@gmail.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 20:14:58 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] fbdev: au1200fb: Fix a memory leak in au1200fb_drv_probe()

In au1200fb_drv_probe(), when platform_get_irq fails(), it directly
returns from the function with an error code, which causes a memory
leak.

Replace it with a goto label to ensure proper cleanup.

Fixes: 4e88761f5f8c ("fbdev: au1200fb: Fix missing IRQ check in au1200fb_drv_probe")
Signed-off-by: Felix Gu <ustc.gu@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Helge Deller <deller@gmx.de>

diff --git a/drivers/video/fbdev/au1200fb.c b/drivers/video/fbdev/au1200fb.c
index ed770222660b..685e629e7e16 100644
--- a/drivers/video/fbdev/au1200fb.c
+++ b/drivers/video/fbdev/au1200fb.c
@@ -1724,8 +1724,10 @@ static int au1200fb_drv_probe(struct platform_device *dev)
 
 	/* Now hook interrupt too */
 	irq = platform_get_irq(dev, 0);
-	if (irq < 0)
-		return irq;
+	if (irq < 0) {
+		ret = irq;
+		goto failed;
+	}
 
 	ret = request_irq(irq, au1200fb_handle_irq,
 			  IRQF_SHARED, "lcd", (void *)dev);
-- 
2.34.1

### Modifications in Each File

- **File: `drivers/video/fbdev/au1200fb.c`**  
  In the `au1200fb_drv_probe()` function, the error handling for a failed `platform_get_irq()` call was changed. Previously, when `irq < 0`, the function immediately returned `irq` (the error code) without any cleanup. The patch replaces this direct return with assignment of the error code to `ret` and a jump to the existing `failed` label, ensuring that previously allocated resources (e.g., framebuffer memory) are properly released.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification is localized to a single file and function. It corrects a resource leak by connecting the newly introduced error path (for `platform_get_irq` failure) to the existing cleanup logic (`failed` label). This ensures that if the IRQ acquisition fails, the function cleans up any resources that were already allocated before returning an error, closing the memory leak.
